scores.claim_text: Equinix operates 280 data centers across 77 markets in 36 countries, including 23 xScale data centers and the MC1 and SN1 IBX data centers held in unconsolidated joint ventures.
supports: 10-K Item 1 Business Overview and Item 2 Properties enumerate the 280-DC global footprint by metro across Americas/EMEA/APAC; Item 2 tables disclose 255 consolidated IBXs (109 Americas / 88 EMEA / 58 APAC) with 392,300 total cabinet capacity and 299,300 cabinets billed (77% utilization)

edgar_fts.query_fulltext('Equinix', forms='10-K,20-F') returned 451 hits across SEC fulltext — extremely high asymmetric mention rate; Equinix is named/referenced as digital-infrastructure vendor in widely diverse issuer filings, consistent with the world's-largest DC-REIT positioning
scores.interpretation: Operational/physical claim with unambiguous internal disclosure (full metro/IBX tables in Item 2) and very strong external corroboration via the asymmetric mention test. Mature DC-REIT control as cohort metadata predicted.

scores.claim_text: Equinix recognized $9.217 billion of total revenue in FY2025 with no single customer accounting for 10% or greater of revenue or A/R; ~$8.7B is recurring (colocation + interconnection + managed infrastructure).
supports: Segment Information note discloses Americas $4,111M + EMEA $3,130M + APAC $1,976M = $9,217M total; recurring revenue $8,739M (colocation $6,475M + interconnection $1,655M + managed $466M + other $143M); non-recurring $478M

Explicit disclosure: 'no single customer accounted for 10% or greater of our accounts receivable or revenues as at or for the year ended December 31, 2025'; same disclosure for 2024 and 2023 — durable diversification, not a single-counterparty pivot
scores.M_check: Internal segment-note cross-tie (no external M-source applicable — diversified colo revenue is below 10-K single-customer disclosure threshold and is not captured by hyperscaler counterparty queries)
scores.M_value: Total rev $9.217B; recurring $8.739B; no >10% customer concentration
scores.interpretation: Recurring revenue from broad colocation base ties the headline directly to GAAP segment results. Calibration Heuristic 11 (BTC-vs-AI recognized-revenue) does not apply — Equinix has no legacy mining revenue and the disclosed mix is real MRR colocation/interconnection. Calibration Heuristic 9 (TCV vs current-period) also does not apply — Equinix headlines current-period GAAP revenue, not multi-year TCV.

scores.claim_text: Equinix discloses xScale data centers are developed and operated through joint-venture partnerships with hyperscale customers (cloud / AI hyperscalers) as core deployment infrastructure.
supports: Item 1 Business explicitly defines xScale as hyperscale-targeted joint-venture product with 23 unconsolidated xScale DCs and EMEA 2 JV credit facility (~$1.1B, EQIX guarantees 20%) corroborating active JV financing

Pre-cutoff 10-K subsequent event note discloses AMER 3 JV transaction (Hampton/Atlanta sale $470M, EQIX contributed $146M for 25% interest) on Jan 13 2026 — operational evidence of ongoing hyperscaler JV scaling
Asymmetric mention test: 451 SEC fulltext hits for 'Equinix' across 10-K/20-F filings is extraordinary corroboration of the broad hyperscaler/enterprise ecosystem position
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext('Equinix', cik=MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL, forms='10-K') counterparty disclosure threshold test
scores.M_value: MSFT 10-K: 0 hits; AMZN 10-K: 0 hits; GOOGL 10-K: 0 hits
scores.interpretation: Counterparty-disclosure threshold (Heuristic 7) is NOT triggered here. Heuristic 7 targets multi-$100M-MW single-counterparty hosting contracts headlined by an AI-DC pivot; Equinix's xScale claim is structurally different (a JV product line with multiple hyperscale tenants across 23 DCs, no single customer >10% of revenue). At hyperscaler scale ($200B+ revenue), colocation/interconnect vendors are categorically immaterial line items and would not be named in 10-K MD&A. Zero hits here is the expected baseline for diversified colo, NOT a contradiction. Strong internal disclosure (xScale JV product, EMEA 2 + AMER 3 JV credit facilities, named JV partner structure) plus 451-hit asymmetric mention test corroborate the relationship class. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Equinix had Annualized Gross Bookings of $1.6 billion in 2025, up 27% YoY, with the metric described as MRR-based on contracts that begin within 90 days (i.e. near-term operational bookings, not headline TCV).
supports: MD&A defines AGB rigorously: 'annualized revenue impact of stated monthly recurring revenues (MRR) on newly executed contracts with a term of 12 months or more, net of any MRR decreases ... excludes contracts for recurring revenue from our joint ventures and the impact of power price adjustments. This measure only includes contracts that we anticipate will start generating revenue within 90 days.' This explicitly separates near-term-deliverable MRR from multi-year TCV
AGB scale ($1.6B) reconciles directionally with reported FY2025 recurring revenue growth: $8,739M (FY25) vs $8,184M (FY24) = +$555M YoY, plus offsets from churn — consistent with a real bookings ramp
scores.M_check: Internal definition + recurring-revenue growth reconciliation (no useful external M-source for a private-contract pipeline metric)
scores.M_value: AGB $1.6B (+27% YoY); recurring rev YoY +$555M; non-recurring rev YoY -$86M
scores.interpretation: This is the EXACT type of disclosure Heuristic 9 (TCV vs current-period revenue conflation) rewards: Equinix explicitly defines AGB on a near-term (90-day) MRR basis rather than headline TCV, and excludes JV revenue (consistent with consolidation accounting). High-quality disclosure; passes Heuristic 3 stage-ladder discipline.

scores.claim_text: Equinix has 52 active major development projects underway across 35 metros expected to deliver 55,000+ retail cabinets and 100+ MW of xScale capacity through 2028, with $6.5B of total capex tied to specific named under-construction projects.
supports: Item 2 Properties provides a fully itemized project table by region (Americas / EMEA / APAC) listing each project name, metro, target open quarter (Q1 2026 – Q4 2028), sellable cabinets, and capex — totals 51,900 sellable cabinets and $6,549M capex. Per-project specificity is granular (e.g. 'DC17 phases 1 and 2 Washington, D.C. Q2 2027 4,700 $622M'; 'DA12 phase 1 Dallas Q2 2028 3,700 $837M')
MD&A discloses $6.3B of unaccrued capex contractual commitments and confirms 2025 capex of $4.311B vs $3.066B in 2024 (+41%) — consistent with the disclosed buildout pipeline being actively funded
Liquidity disclosure shows $3.2B cash + $4.0B revolver + $1.2B ATM remaining + access to debt markets ($4.3B senior notes issued in 2025 alone), corroborating funding capacity for the $6.5B program
scores.M_check: Internal cross-tie between Item 2 project table, MD&A capex commitments, cash flow capex, and Liquidity disclosure
scores.M_value: 51,900 sellable cabinets + $6,549M project capex; FY25 cash capex $4,311M; $6.3B unaccrued capex commitments; $3.2B cash + $4.0B revolver + $1.2B ATM
scores.interpretation: Stage-ladder discipline (Heuristic 3) applied — Equinix consistently delineates under-construction vs operating capacity in both Item 2 and MD&A. No TCV-vs-recognized-revenue conflation. Mature DC-REIT capex disclosure with named substations/sites and quarter-level target dates.

scores.claim_text: Equinix has approximately $18.4B in senior notes principal outstanding and $6.3B of unaccrued capex contractual commitments; FY2025 operating cash flow $3.911B vs investing outflow $6.484B (heavy capex / land buildout).
supports: MD&A Material Cash Commitments lists $18.4B senior notes principal, $4.2B interest, $703M term loans, $5.3B lease payments, $6.3B unaccrued capex, $2.1B non-capital purchase commitments — itemized maturity schedule provided
Cash flow statement: OCF $3,911M, investing -$6,484M, financing +$1,272M; $4.3B senior notes issued in 2025 (denominated in EUR/USD/SGD/CAD) plus $99M ATM proceeds support the funding gap

Liquidity backstops: $3.2B cash, $4.0B undrawn revolver, $1.2B ATM remaining, ongoing access to public/private debt — no going-concern qualifier, no covenant disclosure issue, no reverse split, no Form 15-12G fingerprints (Heuristic 10 negative)
scores.M_value: Debt $18.4B+$703M; capex commitments $6.3B; OCF $3.911B; Investing -$6.484B; Liquidity $3.2B cash + $4.0B revolver + $1.2B ATM
scores.interpretation: REIT capital-structure profile is heavy but appropriate for the asset base ($23.6B PP&E net). Cash flow shortfall vs investing is bridged by debt issuance — standard for a growth REIT. Heuristic 10 distress fingerprints all negative.

scores.claim_text: Equinix received SEC and US Attorney (NDCA) subpoenas in 2024 regarding accounting practices; the SEC closed its investigation on November 19, 2025 with no enforcement action recommended, and the related stockholder class action was settled (covered by insurance) and dismissed with prejudice December 19, 2025.
supports: Item 3 Legal Proceedings and Note 15 (Commitments and Contingencies) disclose both the SEC's November 19, 2025 closure letter (no enforcement action) and the December 19, 2025 final approval / dismissal-with-prejudice of the Section 10(b) class action with settlement fully covered by insurance — material legal-overhang resolution

Two related shareholder derivative suits filed Feb 2025 were voluntarily dismissed (Apr 28 and Aug 19, 2025); one Delaware derivative suit remains pending (MTD filed Oct 20, 2025) — fully disclosed with status and procedural posture
scores.M_check: Internal legal-disclosure cross-tie (Item 3 + Note 15 are duplicative — strong control)
scores.M_value: SEC closed no-action 2025-11-19; class action dismissed with prejudice 2025-12-19, insurance-covered; 2 derivative suits dismissed; 1 Delaware derivative suit pending MTD
scores.interpretation: Net resolution of major legal overhang prior to cutoff. Insurance-covered settlement = no material P&L hit. Remaining Delaware derivative suit is fully disclosed. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Equinix is winding down its Equinix Metal product (announced Q4 2024; final completion expected Q4 2026), and took a Q4 2024 impairment of $131M PP&E + $29M intangibles plus a Hong Kong IBX impairment of $73M; FY2025 impairment charges were $68M.
supports: Note 16 (Restructuring) and Note 17 (Impairments) disclose Q4 2024 Restructuring Plan and Equinix Metal Wind Down with detailed charge-by-quarter tables: Q4 2024 Restructuring Plan $6M (2025) + $27M (2024) = $33M total; Equinix Metal wind-down $6M (2025) + $4M (2024) restructuring + $160M (Q4 2024) impairment

Hong Kong IBX impairment $73M ($38M ROU + $35M PP&E) Q4 2024 disclosed with fair-value methodology and Level 3 input narrative; FY2025 impairment charges $68M (per segment reconciliation); FY2024 was $233M (per segment reconciliation) — orders of magnitude tie
Q4 2024 Restructuring Plan disclosed as completed by March 31, 2025 — closure note matches the segment reconciliation
scores.M_check: Internal Note 16 / Note 17 / segment reconciliation triangulation
scores.M_value: Equinix Metal: $131M PP&E + $29M intangible impairment Q4'24; HK IBX: $38M ROU + $35M PP&E Q4'24; FY25 impairments $68M; FY24 impairments $233M; restructuring fully accrued/paid
scores.interpretation: Discretionary product discontinuation with clean accounting treatment and clear stage disclosure (wind-down by Q4 2026). Heuristic 11 (related-party / circular-revenue) negative — Equinix Metal was an in-house bare-metal product, not a counterparty deal. No going-concern signal. PASS.
